what_was_done.action: Wrap dispatchChainAction's inline marker-routing override branch with buildDispatchContext + evaluatePreconditions BEFORE the /api/fleet/action fetch
what_was_done.result: Modified src/lib/agent-launcher.ts. Added imports for buildDispatchContext + evaluatePreconditions from ./dispatch-preconditions and appendEvent + RECONCILER_ACTION_REFUSED from ./event-log. Inside the existing `if (routingDecision.override && routingDecision.nextAgent)` block (around line 2034), AFTER the existing console.log + structured marker_overrode_default_chain JSON event and BEFORE the fetch, call buildDispatchContext({ epicId: session.epicId, repoPath: session.repoPath, action: actionName }) then evaluatePreconditions(ctx). On refusal: structured warn-line tagged `dispatch_refused_inline` with epicId/action/refusalCode/failedCheck/reason; appendEvent of type RECONCILER_ACTION_REFUSED to session.repoPath with payload.ruleName='dispatchChainAction:inline-marker-routing' + action + refusalCode + failedCheck + reason; return false (preserves existing fall-through semantics — the inline override branch returns false when dispatch did NOT fire). Per-stage branches BELOW the inline override block were NOT touched (out of scope per bead text; route.ts integration covers them via beads_web-ehp.11).

what_was_done.action: Handle HTTP 412 from the action route as a refusal, not an HTTP failure (architecture § Seam 5 defense-in-depth)
what_was_done.result: Inserted a new branch ahead of the existing `if (!res.ok)` error path inside the override branch's try block. If res.status === 412, read the body via res.text() (with .catch(() => '<unreadable>')), log a warn-line tagged `dispatch_refused_inline_at_route` with epicId/action/httpStatus/body, appendEvent of type RECONCILER_ACTION_REFUSED with payload.refusalCode='ROUTE_REFUSED_412' + failedCheck='route-side-precondition' + reason=<body>, return false WITHOUT throwing. Distinguishes route-side precondition refusal (race window between inline check and route check) from a genuine HTTP failure that the existing `if (!res.ok)` console.error + return false path handles. Mirrors beads_web-ehp.4's reconciler-rule pattern.

surprises_or_findings:
1. The existing test mock for fetch in agent-launcher-marker-routing.test.ts did NOT implement res.text() — only `ok` and `status`. The 412 branch reads body via res.text(). Added `text: async () => fetchResponseBody` to the Response shape and a fetchResponseBody capture variable that the 412 test can seed. This is a one-line additive change to the existing mock, no behaviour change for the 7 existing tests (they don't seed fetchResponseBody so it's the empty string default).

2. Adding the precondition gate to dispatchChainAction's inline override branch required mocking @/lib/bead-status-reader at the test-file level. Without the mock, every existing kvn test would refuse with BD_READ_FAILED (correct fail-closed behaviour for unknown synthetic bead-IDs, but wrong for the legacy tests' synthetic fixtures). The fix is a 30-line jest.mock block lifted from the ehp.4 sibling test pattern, defaulting to an open BeadSnapshot. All 7 existing kvn tests pass through the new gate without further changes — this confirms the gate is non-disruptive to happy paths.

3. Per-action predicates (ehp.13's EXTENDED_PRECONDITION_TABLE) are already wired for `run-architect` (the action used by all 3 new tests). The happy-path test would have failed if Class B / D / E predicates fired against the open bead — they don't, because the test fixture has no agent:running, no qa:round-N, no plan-instability conditions, and the marker's next_agent matches the action via getActionForAgent. This is the right shape for the LOAD-BEARING test (it isolates BD_STATUS_DEFERRED from the per-action predicates).

4. The architect memo's text + bead text both refer to the inline branch as 'the third dispatch site' (after route.ts and the marker-driven-routing reconciler rule). The ruleName in the refusal event payload reflects this: 'dispatchChainAction:inline-marker-routing' is distinct from the reconciler rule's 'marker-driven-routing' — operator can grep for either site separately when investigating refusals.

5. Pre-existing TS errors (52 total in the repo per `npx tsc --noEmit`) are NOT in any file I touched. Verified by grepping the tsc output for `agent-launcher.ts` or `agent-launcher-marker-routing` — zero matches. The errors are in wave-bead-mismatch tests, reconciler-bootstrap.ts, and several /api/ test files, all of which were touched by previous beads in this branch's modification set (route.ts, reconciler-bootstrap.ts, repeat-dispatch-escalation.ts, repeated-qa-round.ts, stuck-in-stage.ts, wave-bead-mismatch.ts).
